no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an advisory committee, as it is not the first adenosine deaminase enzyme replacement therapy for ADA-SCID and the application did not raise significant safety or efficacy concerns or controversial scientific issues that would benefit from outside expertise or advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for BLA761092 (Revcovi). The FDA Summary Review and Medical Review both state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it was not the first ADA enzyme replacement therapy for ADA-SCID and raised no significant safety/efficacy or controversial scientific issues. The only external consultation was the Medical Policy and Program Review Council (MPPRC) on June 27, 2018, regarding reclassification from Standard to Priority Review, not an advisory committee, so there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
